notes.title: Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?! Demo is available now (out of nowhere)!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38073166/97ea858329aa82187544958313dd9cac9a113bfd.png

Hey Spudlings,

Long time no see. 
We have been quite busy with our development but finally, we are very excited to show you a new demo for our latest game, Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?!.

What is the game about?
Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?! is a wacky action RPG where YOU'RE the hero! Cook, craft, and toss around epic weapons, barrels of poison, and more as you fulfil your destiny!

What can you expect from the demo?
This is a short demo to showcase our combat mechanics in the game. This demo covers roughly 40% of the mechanics planned for Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?!.
Since some of the mechanics are missing from the demo, you can refer to the FAQs for more information.

For any suggestion for us to improve the game further, please do not hesitate to provide your feedback here or reach out to us directly through our Discord channel.

If you have enjoyed playing our demo, don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

Have fun playing!!

 Daylight Studios
